The transmission inner function changes the flow expression from `var.loc[:, idx] * efficiency[idx]` to `var.loc[:, idx] * -efficiency.sel(name=idx)`. For a selected branch with nonzero flow and nonzero port efficiency, this reverses the reported sign for the same input; it is unconditional and therefore also applies under legacy semantics with the default, `"auto"`, or `"multiindex"` snapshot option.
